python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/shared-launch-python"
"$RUNNER_TEMP/shared-launch-python/bin/pip" install -r tests/shared-launch-python-requirements.txt
"$RUNNER_TEMP/shared-launch-python/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess, sys, tomllib
config = pathlib.Path('tests/shared-launch-python/pyproject.toml')
files = tomllib.loads(config.read_text())['tool']['mypy']['files']
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'ruff', 'check', '--config', str(config), *files], check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'mypy', '--config-file', str(config)], check=True)
PY

npm run build
